svg.title: Aether architecture
svg.desc: Browsers and calendar apps reach the Caddy web server, which serves the Next.js web app and forwards the REST API and CalDAV and CardDAV to the Go API. Identity providers sign people in through the API. Mail apps and other mail servers connect to Postfix and Dovecot. Rspamd filters and signs mail for Postfix, Dovecot stores it as Maildir, the API keeps its data in PostgreSQL, and Rspamd uses Valkey.
